'''Sarannah''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She was a vendor on [[Voss]] in the [[Voss-Ka Cantina]].
